description: Erection of a rear roof extension, including installation of French doors and a Juliet balcony; erection of a rear extension at second floor level, over part of existing back addition; erection of a single storey rear extension, to the side and rear of the existing back addition; installation of 3no. rooflights in the front roof slope; formation of a roof terrace at first floor level, on top of part of the flat roof of the proposed single storey rear extension, and enclosed with a glazed balustrade; installation of French doors to replace existing window to the rear elevation at first floor level, to provide access to the proposed roof terrace; and erection of a brick-built front boundary wall to replace existing front boundary fence.
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall not commence later than the expiration of 3 years beginning with the date of this planning permission.Condition required to be imposed by section 91(1)(a) of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 (as amended by section 51 of the Planning and Compulsory Purchase Act 2004).

Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in complete accordance with the following approved drawing numbers, other than where those details are altered pursuant to the conditions of this planning permission:B316159-3100 Rev.A;B316159-3200 Rev.A;Flood Risk Assessment.To ensure full compliance with the planning application hereby approved and to prevent harm arising through deviations from the approved plans.

Condition : 3 - The development hereby approved shall be carried out and completed in accordance with the materials details (including colour and finish) specified below:- Walls: London stock brick to match the existing building in terms of brick and mortar colour and bond pattern.  	- Roof extensions: Natural or artificial slates/ tiles	- Windows: uPVC, colour to match the existing windows.	- Doors: uPVC.The development shall be permanently retained in accordance with the approved details. Any works of making good to existing elevations shall be carried out in materials to match the elevation to which the works relate.  To ensure a satisfactory external appearance, in accordance with Policies DC1, DC4 and DC8 of the Local Plan (2018).

Condition : 4 - Prior to the commencement of the proposed works the following documents (in consultation with London Underground) for each progressive stage of the development have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority which:
	
	1. Provide detailed design and Risk Assessment Method Statement for all permanent and temporary works including the use of scaffolding, tall plant, crane and lifting equipment and that the risk of collapse is mitigated.
	2. Provide details on access and egress of material delivery and waste removal.
	3. Completion of a glare and glint study to demonstrate that the train drivers' visibility will not be impaired.
	4. The applicant must also demonstrate that the introduction of the balcony will not increase the risk of objects, rubbish, or other materials being dropped or thrown onto LU land or the tracks.
	 
To ensure that the development does not impact on existing London Underground/DLR transport infrastructure, in accordance with the London Plan (2021) Policy T3 and 'Land for Industry and Transport' Supplementary Planning Guidance (2012).

Condition : 5 - The terrace hereby approved shall not be first used until the privacy screening has been installed as shown on approved drawing no. [B316159-3200 Rev.A]. The privacy screen shall achieve a minimum level of obscurity equivalent to Pilkington Texture Glass Level 3 and shall have a height of 1.7m above the finished floor level of the terrace along the side and rear elevations. The privacy screen shall thereafter be permanently retained as approved.

To protect the amenities of neighbouring occupiers in terms of overlooking and privacy in accordance with Policy HO11 of the Local Plan (2018).

Condition : 6 - The balustrade of the Juliet balcony at second floor level in the rear elevation [B316159-3200 Rev.A] hereby permitted shall be fixed flush with the rear elevation of the building at the same time as the associated doors are installed. The doors to the Juliet balconies shall open inwards only. The doors and balustrades shall be permanently retained in this form for the lifetime of the development. 
	
To ensure a satisfactory external appearance and to protect the amenities of adjoining occupiers in terms of privacy and overlooking, in accordance with Policies DC1, DC4, DC8 and HO11 of the Local Plan (2018).

Condition : 7 - The roofs of the extensions, other than the area shown as a terrace on the approved plans, and remainder of the roof of the back addition shall not be converted into or used as a terrace or other open amenity space. No alterations shall be carried out; nor planters or other chattels placed on the roofs/remainder of the roof on or the extensions hereby approved. No railings or other means of enclosure shall be erected around the roofs and no alterations shall be carried out to the property, including the extension hereby approved, to form an access onto the roofs.
	 
Such a use would be detrimental to the amenities of neighbouring properties by reason of overlooking and loss of privacy and potential noise and disturbance, contrary to Policies CC11 and HO11 of the Local Plan (2018).

Condition : 8 - The development shall be carried out and completed in full accordance with the details contained within the approved Flood Risk Assessment [dated April 2026]. No part of the development shall be used or occupied until all flood prevention and mitigation measures have been installed in accordance with the submitted details and the development shall be permanently retained in this form and maintained as necessary thereafter.
	
To limit the impact on flood risk and mitigate the susceptibility of the development to flooding in accordance with Policies CC2, CC3 and CC4 of the Local Plan (2018).
